name: Ogunsen AB (publ)
summary: Stockholm, Sweden-based Ogunsen AB (publ) delivers expert recruitment and consultancy services. The firm assists specialists and managers across Sweden in the information technology, finance, human resources, and supply chain industries. Founded in 1993, the company operated as SJR in Scandinavia AB (publ) before adopting its present name, Ogunsen AB (publ), in November 2021.
